persons.name: Amelia
persons.harm: Her husband, in active opioid then methamphetamine addiction, subjected her to escalating emotional abuse, night-time harassment, phone stalking, threats (including a gun-store location pin), took their son and demanded $5,000, and finally broke in and set the family home on fire.

contacts.what_happened_next: Harassment continued.

contacts.what_was_asked: Cut off his access to her phone account / stalking
contacts.what_institution_did: Security worked to remove him from the account and shut his phone off but could not stop him reconnecting.
contacts.quote: they said this guy is good. We don't know how he's getting through all these walls, we keep shutting his phone off and he keeps turning it back on and we don't know how he's doing it.
contacts.what_happened_next: He kept access; texted her the gun-store pin.

contacts.when: after the gun-store pin and 'go quietly' texts
contacts.what_was_asked: Protection from a perceived death threat
contacts.what_institution_did: Met her at the house, held him outside while she collected her things.
contacts.quote: I told the sheriff, I'm not comfortable coming home today. And he said, okay, we'll hold him outside and you go in and you get your things. And then you can leave.
contacts.what_happened_next: She found the shrine upstairs.

contacts.what_was_asked: Action on the shrine of defaced photos and journals
contacts.what_institution_did: Looked at it and said it was not illegal.
contacts.quote: And he looks at it and I said, this is not normal. And he said, oh, it's definitely crazy, but crazy is not illegal. We can't do anything.
contacts.what_happened_next: She went to stay with a friend.

contacts.institution: the boys' daycare (on her work campus)
contacts.what_was_asked: Alert her if he showed up

contacts.quote: I go inside, the director of the daycare has the phone in her handage that I was just about to call you.
contacts.what_happened_next: He drove off with the boy unrestrained and demanded $5,000.

contacts.when: the day he took their son and demanded $5,000

contacts.what_institution_did: Clerk identified it as domestic violence; judge granted the order requiring him to leave the house.
contacts.quote: Basically saying he has to leave the house immediately.
contacts.what_happened_next: Order could not take effect until served.
contacts.notes: Clerk: 'she looks at me and she said, that's domestic violence. And it was the first time that finally somebody validated...' (e2 @ 24:48). contacts.when: that night, when he came home and stood over her

contacts.what_happened_next: 'If you show up here again, you're going to jail.' (e2 @ 30:57). A deputy later told her he was arrested for a meth DUI.

contacts.quote: but that he would allow monitored visitation with our children, so long as it was monitored by his mom. And I agreed to that because his mom adores her grandkids.

contacts.what_happened_next: She felt the sentence was unfair: 'Quite honestly that felt so unfair at the time.'

Second witnesses: sister and best friend. Outcome coded harmed_by_institution because the couples therapist endangered her and no later institutional protection came; a reader could argue not_protected.

coder_notes: All 12 season-13 chunk files (episodes 1-22) were read to their last lines; the run was interrupted several times by usage limits and the first set of notes was lost, so reading restarted from s13_01 and notes.md was written after each file. Unassigned: INDEX read; three episodes opened (none continued a season-13 story); the others were judged unrelated from their titles/descriptions (other seasons, guests, trailers). Perpetrator names (show pseudonyms) are replaced with [perpetrator] in all quotations, including the names of people only suspected (Ruksana's case). Some quotations still contain first names of non-harmed third parties where cutting them would break the verbatim passage; I avoided these where possible. Judgement calls flagged in each record's notes: Amelia's outcome (protected, despite a judge reprimanding her); Odessa coded harmed_by_institution because of a couples therapist; Whitney's hospital coded protected_itself; Arya's university response coded protected_itself and outcome not_protected because she had already left before reporting.
